title: Horrible, Thin Cream Mats - Not Grey!!
text:
Horrible, Thin Cream Mats - Not Grey!!. These mats are THIN, and nowhere near grey!! You can see them in the foreground, with the fabulous grey mats I had bought from Wellhouse May in the background. They do not match even slightly - these are more like a cream!
I am so very disappointed as I'd wanted to set my table - silicone mats are great for everyday spills.
I cannot return them easily as I live in Jamaica. I would never ever order these mats again.
This is why accuracy in discriptions is so important!
Back to square one🙈
